description: Statistics Botswana published the analytical reports of the 2022 Population and Housing Census as separate PDF volumes on its census page. Volume 5 has a chapter on household energy, analysed from the census microdata, with the principal sources of energy for lighting, main and alternative cooking and heating of space or water across 695,561 cases, green energy for cooking by district, and national trends in lighting, cooking and heating sources back to the 1981 census. It notes, for example, that firewood is used for cooking by 85.8 percent in the Delta district. Volume 4 covers household transport, ICT access, agriculture and land ownership. Coverage is national by district. Format and access: free PDFs, no registration; a data portal and a national summary data page are linked. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: results are analytical tables and charts in PDFs, not a table series; the census 2022 data page returned only a header row of population by village when fetched; no dwelling or water supply tables were found in the volumes read. Simulation uses: district energy mixes for electrification and clean cooking planning, and solar adoption for off-grid supply. Related records: none for Botswana censuses in the catalogue.
